title: Specialize Vector3<bool> as Bit-Packed
prompt: The generic `Vector3<T>` wastes a byte per bool. Write a **full specialization** `Vector3<bool>` that packs the three flags into one `unsigned` and reports `storage = "bit-packed"`.

tests.name: specialization reports bit-packed storage
tests.hint: template <> struct Vector3<bool> { ... static constexpr const char* storage = "bit-packed"; };

tests.name: bits round-trip independently
tests.hint: set: bits_ |= (1u << i) when true, bits_ &= ~(1u << i) when false; get: (bits_ >> i) & 1u.
